description:
Use this when the user wants to see the long videos already in RipClip (Twitch or Kick stream VODs, podcast
        episodes, uploads) or needs a project_id: "what videos do I have", "which stream did I import". Returns up to 50
        per page (limit 1-50; pass next_cursor as cursor for the next page) with each project's id and name. The id is
        what estimate_hu, find_clips, find_moments and clip_range take as project_id.
        Not for: finished clips (list_clips), rendered files in the Library (list_library), or searching inside a video
        for a topic (find_moments). Free and read only; private file paths are never returned.
name: list_projects
title: List projects
